name: Agent_Humanization_Benchmark
description: Agent Humanization Benchmark evaluates how human-like conversational agents (chatbots/virtual assistants) appear to human judges. It measures perceived humanness across agent responses using crowd or expert ratings and/or pairwise comparisons. The benchmark is intended to diagnose anthropomorphism and naturalness in agent behavior across different prompts and settings.
reputation: Niche benchmark with modest community use for human-AI interaction studies; not widely standardized across major NLP leaderboards.
